message.reasoning: We need to answer: earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record. Likely earliest non-Christian references: Josephus (Antiquities 18.3), Tacitus (Annals 15.44), Pliny the Younger (letters). Also maybe the earliest Christian references: the Gospels (written ~70-90 AD). But question: "earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" So likely earliest mention outside Christian texts: Josephus (c. 93-94 AD) and Tacitus (c. 116 AD). Josephus's passage is debated but considered earliest. So answer: Josephus's Antiquities of the Jews, Book 18, Chapter 3, around 93-94 AD. Provide details. Also mention that earliest Christian references are the Gospels, written around 70-90 AD. Provide context. Also mention that the earliest mention in Roman sources is Tacitus's Annals (c. 116 AD). Provide citations. Also mention that the earliest mention in Christian literature is the Gospel of Mark (~70 AD). Provide explanation. Also mention that the earliest mention in non-Christian sources is Josephus.
